use keel_frontend::FunctionBuilder;
use keel_ir::{Function, Module, Signature, Target, Type};
use object::{Object, ObjectSection};

fn main() {
    let mut function = Function::new("main", Signature::new(&[], &[Type::I32]));
    let mut builder = FunctionBuilder::new(&mut function);
    let block = builder.create_block();
    builder.switch_to_block(block);
    builder.seal_block(block);
    let a = builder.ins().iconst(Type::I32, 19);
    let b = builder.ins().iconst(Type::I32, 23);
    let result = builder.ins().iadd(a, b);
    builder.ins().return_(&[result]);
    builder.finalize();
    let mut module = Module::default();
    module.functions.push(function);
    keel_ir::verify_module(&module).unwrap();
    keel_opt::optimize_with_tier(&mut module, keel_opt::OptimizationTier::Full).unwrap();
    keel_ir::verify_module(&module).unwrap();
    let program = keel_codegen::compile_program(&module, Target::Aarch64AppleDarwin).unwrap();
    let macho =
        keel_asm::assemble_program_object(&program, keel_asm::TargetFeatures::default()).unwrap();
    let file = object::File::parse(macho.as_slice()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(file.architecture(), object::Architecture::Aarch64);
    assert!(file.section_by_name("__text").unwrap().size() > 0);
    println!(
        "aarch64 backend text={}",
        file.section_by_name("__text").unwrap().size()
    );
    let program = keel_codegen::compile_program(&module, Target::X86_64LinuxGnu).unwrap();
    let elf = keel_asm::x86::assemble_program_object(&program).unwrap();
    let file = object::File::parse(elf.as_slice()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(file.architecture(), object::Architecture::X86_64);
    assert!(file.section_by_name(".text").unwrap().size() > 0);
    println!(
        "x86 backend text={}",
        file.section_by_name(".text").unwrap().size()
    );
    #[cfg(full_backend)]
    {
        let sdk = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("SDKROOT").unwrap());
        let system = keel_link::Dylib::from_tbd(&sdk.join("usr/lib/libSystem.tbd"), &sdk).unwrap();
        let executable = keel_link::link(
            &[keel_link::Input {
                name: "backend.o",
                bytes: &macho,
            }],
            keel_link::Options {
                dylibs: vec![system],
                ..keel_link::Options::default()
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(!executable.bytes.is_empty());
        let executable = object::File::parse(executable.bytes.as_slice()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(executable.kind(), object::ObjectKind::Executable);
        println!(
            "linker executable architecture={:?}",
            executable.architecture()
        );
    }
}
